FAQs
Is Churnkey just a cancel flow tool, or full customer retention software?
Cancel flows are one part of it. Churnkey is complete customer retention software built for Stripe, covering cancel flows, payment recovery, churn metrics, and AI-driven retention insights in one platform.
How does Churnkey work with Stripe?
Connect your Stripe account and Churnkey syncs directly with your billing data. No separate integration to maintain, no second source of truth.
How long does setup take?
As little as 15 minutes. We'll walk you through it if you want a hand.
Can I cancel anytime?
Yes, month-to-month plans can be canceled anytime. Annual plans are available at a discount but never required.
What are the best alternatives to building cancellation flows in-house?
Churnkey. It gives you a tested cancel flow without the engineering time, either as a hosted product or as an open-source SDK you run yourself. Most teams weigh the cost of building and maintaining it against a 15-minute Stripe integration and choose Churnkey.

Got questions?
Pricing Questions
What payment providers do you support?
We currently support Stripe, Chargebee, Maxio, Paddle, and Braintree. We do offer a custom integration framework that allows you to connect Churnkey to any payment provider or subscription management. Chat with us if you'd like to discuss further.
Will you help me set it up?
Absolutely. We're quick to answer questions, and we'll even set up a call to walk you through the install. Many of our customers like us to be "on call" while they implement, even though a number of our customers have implemented Churnkey within 15-25 minutes.
What does it take to implement?
You can set Churnkey up in as little as 15 minutes (we've seen it happen). If you get fancier with segmentation or test environments, that adds a bit of overhead. Check out our documentation .
Is the SDK open source?
Yes. The Churnkey SDK is open source on GitHub and free to use on any plan. @churnkey/react ships as a drop-in component, a headless hook, and a framework-agnostic state machine. The @churnkey/mcp server lets Claude, Cursor, and other AI agents query your Churnkey data. Starting with React, with more on the way. See sdk.churnkey.co .
Can I cancel at any time?
We offer month-to-month payment options which can be canceled at any time. We also offer annual payment options at a discounted rate but it isn't a requirement.
Can I talk with you about Churnkey now?
Of course. Chat with us using this link or the black button in the bottom right of this page.
How do you calculate pricing?
Our pricing is driven by your average monthly churned revenue. The more revenue your churn, the more Churnkey is able to go save your business. The price is fixed for 12 months so you don't experience billing increases if your business scales. Each year we revisit your metrics and pricing.

Get more out of Churnkey in 15 minutes.
New features are easy to miss when you're busy. Most take minutes to switch on. Block 15 minutes every Thursday, join us live, and see exactly how the latest one works.

Why join
Fifteen minutes, one feature, running before you leave
A small lever on revenue
Each feature is a small change with a real chance to lift your recovery rate. Keep a few more customers, and make a little more every month.
Effortless to turn on
Most features take minutes to switch on. We show you where the settings live and how to use them, so you can turn it on with confidence.
Shape what comes next
The group stays small by design, so your perspective reaches the people shaping the roadmap.

What we cover
A different feature each week
Some weeks it's something that just shipped. Other weeks it's an older feature worth a second look. So you can join any Thursday and still leave with something to switch on.
New releases
What just shipped, why we built it, and how to switch it on in your account.
Features worth a second look
Settings that are easy to miss, and the ones that make the biggest difference once they're on.
What you ask for
Tell us on the call what you'd like to see, and we'll take it into account when we pick topics.
Hosted by Lucas, on the product team
The person who built the feature is the one showing it, so questions get straight answers and feedback goes to someone who can ship it. Groups stay small, and nobody cares if your camera is off.
Still unsure?
Common questions
Anything else, ask us on the call.
Is it really just 15 minutes?
Yes. One feature, quick in and out. You'll be back to your day in no time.
Do I need to prepare anything?
Nothing at all. Turn up with your coffee. If you want to follow along in your own account, keep a Churnkey tab open—but plenty of people watch.
Does it still run if nobody shows up?
It runs every Thursday, and it stays on the calendar either way. So if it turns out to be just you and us, you get a private walkthrough.
Is this only for customers?
No. If you're weighing up Churnkey, this is the least sales-y way to see how it works. Come and watch.
What if I already know the feature?
Skip that week, or drop in for the last five minutes and use the time to tell us what you want built next. That part is genuinely useful to us.

Data API
Access your data through our API.
Copy for AI View Markdown
🤖
The Churnkey MCP server wraps these endpoints as a Model Context Protocol tool surface for Claude, Cursor, and other agents. MCP authenticates per user via OAuth rather than with the Data API key; the key remains the credential for direct server-to-server calls documented on this page.
Authorization
Authorization is done with your data API key, which is distinct from the Cancel Flow API key. Once you have your key, you will pass it along with your application ID as request headers. You can find your API keys and App ID on Churnkey | Settings | Account .
HEADERS
{
" x-ck-api-key " : " data_your_key... " ,
" x-ck-app " : " appIdHere " ,
" content-type " : " application/json "
}
List Sessions
This endpoint will return an array of sessions, optionally filtered. This is limited to returning 10,000 sessions per request.
GET " https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/sessions "
HEADERS
{
" x-ck-api-key " : " data_your_key... " ,
" x-ck-app " : " appIdHere " ,
" content-type " : " application/json "
}
Optionally, you can include the following filters as query params.
Filter Example Description
limit 10 Maximum number of sessions to return (default: 100, max: 10,000)
skip 10 Number of sessions to skip for manual pagination. Use with limit for paginated results.
startDate 2023-01-01 Sessions that occurred after this date according to new Date(startDate)
endDate 2024-01-01 Sessions that occurred before this date according to new Date(endDate)
customerId cus_123789 The exact customer ID.
trial true If customer was on a subscription trial at the time of session
billingInterval MONTH Customer subscription billing interval. Possible values are WEEK , MONTH , YEAR
planId billing_plan_id The exact billing plan ID.
aborted true If session was abandoned before completion
canceled true If customer canceled their subscription
offerType PAUSE Type of accepted offer if accepted. Possible values are PAUSE , DISCOUNT , CONTACT , PLAN_CHANGE , REDIRECT , TRIAL_EXTENSION
saveType ABANDON Type of accepted offer if accepted, or ABANDON if session was abandoned before completion. Possible values are PAUSE , DISCOUNT , CONTACT , PLAN_CHANGE , REDIRECT , TRIAL_EXTENSION , ABANDON
couponId coupon_abc12 The ID of the coupon if the customer accepted a discount offer.
pauseDuration 2 How long the customer paused their subscription for if they accepted a pause offer.
blueprintId id-goes-here-7890 ID of the version of the published Cancel Flow.
abtest guid-goes-here-7890 ID of an ongoing or completed AB test.
bounced true By default, bounced is set to false and bounced sessions are excluded (see note below).
💡
A session gets marked as bounced if another more relevant session takes place within 24 hours of that initial session. For instance, if a customer pauses and then decides to cancel within 24 hours, that first session with the pause offer accepted will be marked as bounced.
Examples of List Session Requests
Returns sessions for the month of May 2023
GET "https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/sessions?startDate=2023-05-01&endDate=2023-06-01"
Returns sessions where monthly customers accepted a discount
GET "https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/sessions?offerType=DISCOUNT&billingInterval=MONTH"
Manual Pagination Examples
Use limit and skip parameters together to implement manual pagination:
First page - Get the first 10 sessions:
GET "https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/sessions?limit=10"
Second page - Get sessions 11-20:
GET "https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/sessions?limit=10&skip=10"
Third page - Get sessions 21-30:
GET "https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/sessions?limit=10&skip=20"

Aggregated Session Data
This endpoint will return an array of grouped session counts. Like the above session listing endpoint, this data can be filtered. Additionally, it can be aggregated by nested groups.
GET " https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/session-aggregation "
HEADERS
{
" x-ck-api-key " : " data_your_key... " ,
" x-ck-app " : " appIdHere " ,
" content-type " : " application/json "
}
In addition to the above filters, you can group the session aggregation by adding any of the following to the breakdown query param, separating each with a - e.g. ?breakdown=month-saveType
Filter Description
month Which month the session occurred in.
trial If customer was on a subscription trial at the time of session
billingInterval Customer subscription billing interval. Possible values are WEEK , MONTH , YEAR
planId The exact billing plan ID.
aborted If session was abandoned before completion
canceled If customer canceled their subscription
offerType Type of accepted offer if accepted. Possible values are PAUSE , DISCOUNT , CONTACT , PLAN_CHANGE , REDIRECT , TRIAL_EXTENSION
saveType Type of accepted offer if accepted, or ABANDON if session was abandoned before completion. Possible values are PAUSE , DISCOUNT , CONTACT , PLAN_CHANGE , REDIRECT , TRIAL_EXTENSION , ABANDON
couponId The ID of the coupon if the customer accepted a discount offer.
pauseDuration How long the customer paused their subscription for if they accepted a pause offer.
blueprintId ID of the version of the published Cancel Flow.
abtest ID of an ongoing or completed AB test.
Examples of Aggregate Session Requests
A month-by-month breakdown of the different types of offers accepted since the start of 2023
GET "https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/session-aggregation?startDate=2023-01-01&breakdown=month-offerType"
A month-by-month breakdown of the survey responses for monthly vs annual customers
GET "https://api.churnkey.co/v1/data/session-aggregation?startDate=2023-01-01&breakdown=month-surveyResponse-billingInterval"
